caseName: Japan Line, Ltd. v. County of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: Japan Line, Ltd. v. County of Los Angeles

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Cal. Motion of Sea Land Service, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Further consideration of question of jurisdiction postponed to hearing of case on the merits. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States.
